_comment: Example holder proof presented alongside an AID to demonstrate possession. The proof is the canonical-JSON-serialized payload below, signed with the agent's Ed25519 private key (delivered once at issuance). The signature is base64url-encoded. Verifiers extract the public key from credentialSubject.holderKey of the signed AID (NEVER from a database) and verify ed25519.verify(sig, canonicalJson(proof), pubkey).
